messages:
jules (People Ops): Quick sweep: final-week cleanup for the review cycle. We still have ~18 rows flagged as 'awaiting reviewer confirmation' and a handful with missing manager sign-offs. Plan: triage tonight, bulk remind tomorrow morning.

matt (HRBP): Thanks. Can you confirm whether missing manager sign-offs block calibration packets from being generated? Some leads said they need the docs for calibration.

jules (People Ops): Short answer: yes 0% of calibration packets require manager-signed reviews. We'll generate provisional packets for calibration chairs with placeholders for unsigned rows, but those placeholders will be excluded from final calcs until sign-off.

kevin (Eng Manager): I have two reviewers OOO until Monday and one reviewer who hasn't opened any review forms. If we bulk remind, can we also request alternate reviewers?

aneli (People Ops): Yes. If a reviewer cannot complete, manager should nominate a backfill reviewer in the tracker (column: reviewer-backfill) and ping HRBP to approve the swap. We'll note that swap in the packet.

ops-bot: Reminder: review forms auto-lock in 36 hours for this cycle. (auto)

recruiting-ops: Heads-up: any late manager sign-offs that change calibration outcomes may affect offer windows. Please flag rows that impact active offers.

jules (People Ops): Triage plan:
1) Tonight (8pm PT): run validator for missing signatures and duplicates.
2) Tomorrow 9am PT: send automated nudge to managers + second nudge at 1pm.
3) Managers with >3 unsigned after 24h get manual ping from People Ops.

jules (People Ops): Validator command (for transparency):
```
python tools/review_validator.py --cycle=Q2-2026 --check signatures,duplicates,attachments --out=validation_report.csv
```

matt (HRBP): If managers nominate backfills, do we allow cross-team reviewers? Concern about conflict of interest.

aneli (People Ops): Allow cross-team backfills only with manager approval and HRBP sign-off. Add note in the tracker with reasoning. We'll redact if conflict is flagged by any stakeholder.

kevin (Eng Manager): I'll nominate two backfills for my team and mark impacted rows. Also will flag one candidate whose compensation might change pending cal.

jules (People Ops): Great. After the 9am nudge we'll post a short summary here with counts: unsigned, duplicates, backfills nominated. If you need manual help sooner, DM me. :memo:
